title: 200-Hour Registered Yoga Teacher
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: 200-Hour Registered Yoga Teacher - Certificate of Achievement: Miramar
outcomes: Create a safe and effective multi-level class experience. Instruct appropriate progressions and regressions of yoga poses (asanas) to create a safe and effective multi-level class experience.
Design intelligently structured and sequenced yoga classes. Design intelligently structured and sequenced yoga classes.
Teaching methodologies and communication skills. Demonstrate appropriate teaching methodologies and effective communication skills while leading a varied group of yoga participants

blocks.name: Complete at least one unit from the following courses:

notes: The outcomes are printed run together; each appears to consist of a short title followed by a statement (e.g. 'Create a safe and effective multi-level class experience.' then 'Instruct appropriate progressions...'). Each outcome is recorded as the full title-plus-statement text as printed; the second outcome's title and statement are identical in the source. A reviewer may prefer only the statement portion.
No careers are named in the program section; the job types listed (yoga teachers, group fitness instructors, personal trainers, etc.) appear only in course descriptions and were not recorded.
The program description refers to the Yoga Alliance 200-Hour RYT certification, but the award is counted in semester units (Total Units: 8.0).
